heading: 👜 Prize Bags
intro: Some things are sure to happen, some never will, and most are somewhere in between. Where does each one go on the chance scale?

events.text: A bag has 6 gold tokens and nothing else. You pull out a gold token.
events.hint: Every token in the bag is gold — could you ever miss?

events.text: A bag has 1 star token and 9 plain tokens. You pull out the star.
events.hint: Only 1 out of 10 is a star. That can happen, but not often.
A coin has two sides, each just as likely.

events.text: A bag has only red tokens. You pull out a blue one.
events.hint: Are there any blue tokens in there at all?

events.text: A bag has 8 prize tokens and 2 plain ones. You pull a prize.
events.hint: 8 out of 10 is most of the bag — but not all of it.
